refnamediv.refpurpose: interactive client for MGED socket server

refsect1.title: DESCRIPTION
refsect1.para: mged_socket_client connects to an MGED socket server and provides an interactive or batch interface for executing geometry commands. The MGED socket server must be started with the -s option to create a Unix domain socket.
The client supports a simple protocol using Unicode control characters for message framing. Commands are sent to the server and responses are parsed and displayed in a human-readable format.

listitem.para: Batch mode. Read commands from standard input instead of running interactively. Useful for scripting.

refsect1.title: INTERACTIVE MODE
refsect1.para: In interactive mode, the client provides a command prompt with special key bindings for inserting protocol control characters:

listitem.para: Insert Group Separator (\u241d) to separate command arguments.
Insert File Separator (\u241c) and send the command immediately.
Send the command (File Separator is added automatically).

refsect1.para: Control characters are displayed using visible Unicode symbols: \u241c for File Separator and \u241d for Group Separator.

refsect1.title: PROTOCOL
refsect1.para: The MGED socket protocol uses two control characters:

listitem.para: Group Separator (GS, \x1D, \u241d): Separates the command from its arguments and separates arguments from each other.

refsect1.title: EXAMPLES
refsect1.literallayout: $ mged_socket_client /tmp/mged.sock > ls Status: OK Result: _GLOBAL sphere.s box.r
$ echo "units" | mged_socket_client -b /tmp/mged.sock Status: OK Result: mm
refsect1.para: (Use Ctrl+G to insert \u241d separators between arguments)

refsect1.title: SEE ALSO
refsect1.para: For detailed protocol specification, see the MGED Socket Server article in the BRL-CAD documentation.
